scripts.build: npm run assets && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: python -m ruff format --check python/mountain_climber tests && python -m ruff check python/mountain_climber tests
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:rom && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=python python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
